item.title: Press release: Cyber and supply chain risks reshaping Japan’s business landscape, Aon survey
item.description: 12th February 2026 – Aon plc (NYSE: AON), a leading global professional services firm, has released the Japan findings of its 2025 Global Risk Management Survey. The survey reveals that Japanese businesses are navigating a complex landscape marked by persistent cyber threats, supply chain disruptions and weather/natural disasters. The post Press release: Cyber and supply chain risks reshaping Japan’s business landscape, Aon survey first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Smart contracts move into real-world trade as Unloq completes its first financing deal
item.description: 13th February 2026 – Unloq today announced the completion of its first live smart-contract-based trade financing transaction, funding commercial receivables using XUSD. The post Press release: Smart contracts move into real-world trade as Unloq completes its first financing deal first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Budget 2026 – gain clarity in uncertainty: The KPMG Clarity Brief
item.description: 14th February 2026 – KPMG has released its strategic paper of the latest Budget announcements: "Gain clarity in uncertainty: The KPMG Clarity Brief”. The post Press release: Budget 2026 – gain clarity in uncertainty: The KPMG Clarity Brief first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Millions in losses drive return to FX protection in 2026
item.description: 17th February 2026 – A new report from advanced FX and cash management solutions provider, MillTech, has revealed that UK corporates lost an average of £6.71m in 2025 due to unhedged FX exposure, while US firms lost $9.85m, driving a renewed focus on currency protection in 2026. The post Press release: Millions in losses drive return to FX protection in 2026 first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Eaton Square’s Silicon creates partnership with Klear to strengthen critical mineral supply chains
item.description: 16th February 2026 – Australian founded company Eaton Square, today announced the strategic integration of its subsidiary, Silicon, with Klear, a leading Capital Intelligence leader in the United States, creating a unified rare earths and metal supply and financing solution for multinational energy and industrial clients. The post Press release: Eaton Square’s Silicon creates partnership with Klear to strengthen critical mineral supply chains first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: UK consumers show curiosity but low understanding of digital currency payments; Gen Z driving future momentum
item.description: 17th February 2026 – New research from FIS suggests that digital currencies, such as cryptocurrencies and stablecoins, are firmly on the radar of younger consumers, but limited understanding and concerns around transparency continue to hold back wider adoption across the UK. The post Press release: UK consumers show curiosity but low understanding of digital currency payments; Gen Z driving future momentum first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: FERMA launches Next Gen Risk Council for young professionals
item.description: 12th February 2026 – FERMA has announced the launch of its Next Gen Risk Council – the first of its kind for the Federation. This new initiative aims to give greater visibility to the next generation of risk leaders and amplify their voice on the European stage. The post Press release: FERMA launches Next Gen Risk Council for young professionals first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: Supply chain financing: durable global trade in the age of AI
item.description: 5th February 2026 – The 2026 edition of Citi’s Supply Chain Financing report examines the shifting dynamics of global trade and assesses the real outcomes of tariff policy and the rapid proliferation of artificial intelligence. The post Press release: Supply chain financing: durable global trade in the age of AI first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Press release: UK economy is ‘cooling’ says market analyst
item.description: 18th February 2026 – Daniela Hathorn, Senior Market Analyst, Capital.com: “UK inflation eased as expected in January with the headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) rate felling to around 3.0% year-on-year, down from 3.4% in December." The post Press release: UK economy is ‘cooling’ says market analyst first appeared on Treasury Today.

item.title: Rising to the challenge
item.description: In the final Future Treasury & Finance Leaders Forum of 2025, industry experts assembled in New York to discuss treasury’s increasing prominence within the organisation, and the importance of investing in personal growth. The post Rising to the challenge first appeared on Treasury Today.
